propositions: The MCP server signs op-cert attestations (plan-review cert at claim, completion cert at close) using a mounted private key from the ContextVar binding, but verification fails because it looks for the public key only in the tracker genesis directory which is empty.

Sign-side ensure_opcert_key resolves the private key from the binding first, then REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH, then tracker genesis, but verify-side _opcert_own_public_key consults neither the binding nor REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH and returns None when tracker has no .opcert-key.pub file.
Every op-cert signed by the deployed server is permanently uncertifiable on the same box, causing claim_gate_check to refuse all tickets and completion_verifier to record unverifiable signatures.

The fix requires verify-side to resolve the public key from the same ordered chain as sign-side (binding, REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH, tracker genesis) and derive it in-process with ssh-keygen -y rather than reading from a file.
